related.description: ⌚️A oh-my-zsh plugin, printing the working hours of the current week tracked in toggl.com (for OSX).
Free, open-source screen time tracker for Windows. Monitors app usage, tracks browser tabs, sets daily limits. No cloud, no accounts.
A "native-like" OS X, Windows, & Linux desktop app for Google Allo
